about: Single source of truth for what the document sandbox image ships. The Dockerfile installs every python[].pip from this file and fails the build when an import or a cli[] binary is missing (verify_env.py). backend/src/services/agent-runner/sandbox-capabilities.json is a byte-identical copy the agent prompt is built from (a test enforces it).

recipes.how: ezdxf: doc = ezdxf.new('R2018', setup=True); msp = doc.modelspace(); add_line/add_lwpolyline/add_text, layers with doc.layers.add, dimensions with msp.add_linear_dim(...).render(); doc.saveas('outputs/plano.dxf'). Preview: from ezdxf.addons.drawing import matplotlib as dm; dm.qsave(msp, 'previews/plano.png', bg='#FFFFFF') (white sheet; export the same to outputs/plano.pdf for a printable plan). Set doc.units = ezdxf.units.M (or CM/MM) to match the user's dimensions.
matplotlib (import matplotlib; matplotlib.use('Agg')): fig.savefig('outputs/x.png', dpi=200, bbox_inches='tight'); seaborn for statistics.
plotly: fig.write_html('outputs/x.html', include_plotlyjs=True) — the file works offline.
reportlab (precise layout) or weasyprint (HTML + CSS: weasyprint.HTML(string=html).write_pdf('outputs/x.pdf')); an office file to PDF: soffice --headless --convert-to pdf --outdir outputs <file>.
build the docx/xlsx/pptx, then soffice --headless --convert-to odt|ods|odp|rtf --outdir outputs <file>; epub: pandoc in.md -o outputs/x.epub or ebooklib.

trimesh (trimesh.creation.box/cylinder, boolean-free unions with trimesh.util.concatenate); mesh.export('outputs/x.stl').
simplekml, gpxpy; GeoJSON with json + shapely.geometry.mapping.

docxcompose.composer.Composer(master).append(part) composes a new document; inspect it independently with docx2python. Headers and footers follow the master document: compare them explicitly before delivery. striprtf.striprtf.rtf_to_text extracts text only, not a format-preserving edit.

Use jsonpatch test operations before replacements, then jsonschema.Draft202012Validator with an explicit local schema. jmespath queries without changing data. ijson.items(file, "item") streams JSON arrays with exact decimals. Keep identifiers as strings and compare untouched fields after edits.

pint.UnitRegistry converts compatible units and rejects incompatible dimensions; uncertainties propagates measurement error. svgpathtools.parse_path reads Bezier paths for bbox(), length() and transformed geometry. Reopen the SVG and check bounds before rendering with CairoSVG.

Altair: embed records with alt.Data(values=records), define axes and units, save the chart specification, and render through vl_convert.vegalite_to_svg/png/pdf. Use only local embedded data. Retain the specification alongside the exported chart; inspect labels, bounds and rendering.

Use pyarrow with an explicit schema including decimal128, string and nullability. DuckDB can query local Parquet with threads=1, memory_limit="256MB", enable_external_access=false, autoinstall_known_extensions=false and autoload_known_extensions=false; register in-memory Arrow tables when external access is disabled. Reopen the output through both engines and compare values/types. Process larger inputs in batches within sandbox limits.

RapidFuzz proposes candidate matches and scores; never silently pick an ambiguous match for a destructive edit. ImageHash pHash/wHash is a perceptual review signal only: retain byte hashes and compare actual pixels and document structure for exact preservation.
